officialPrimarySources.observation: City page lists cadastre consultation and printing as a local urban-planning service.
Official IGN API record: open access, JSON/GeoJSON, WGS84 geometry filtering; PCI Express is available.
IGN documentation: queries official Geoportal WFS sources; bounded geometry requests return GeoJSON; PCI Express is the current recommended product.
Open cadastre catalog documents current PCI coverage, parcel Polygon/MultiPolygon layers, commune-level downloads, Open Licence.
INSEE confirms Marseille commune code 13055 used in the query.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: One public PCI parcel intersects the exact WUP settlement point. No surrounding properties or owner/address fields are retained. Cadastre geometry does not establish title boundaries; no citywide completeness is asserted.

geometryEvidence.limitations: One point-intersecting parcel only. Other attributes returned by API were not retained. Cadastral mapping is not title evidence.

privacy: No owner/address properties or credentials are retained. Marseille sample retains only native IDU and geometry; no owner/plot report was queried for other cities.

rootRuntimeReview.reason: 331 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 331 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32631 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Marseille commune; the unchanged WUP point lies within returned parcel geometry. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
